phase_name: Strict-mode audit, classification, and convention doc

objectives.description: Re-derive set-e/set-uo/no-set populations live and classify every non-e file into Class A/B/C

deviations.description: Run scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh --write to set the new doc's line_count
deviations.reason: The generator refuses to run from the source store (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts) by design -- it requires a deployed .claude/scripts/ tree, and deploying was out of scope for this dispatch (source-store-only edits). line_count was set by hand from a direct wc -l on the new file instead.
